title: Currency conversion failed for unsupported currencies
description: Payments in CHF returned HTTP 500 because the conversion helper assumed every currency code existed in the rate cache.
root_cause: Missing guard clause for unknown currency codes in convert().

title: Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes
description: The validator accepted three-letter codes that were not ISO-4217, so authorisation failed downstream at the acquirer.
root_cause: Validation rule checked length only, not the currency catalogue.

title: Refund service failed after payment validation change
description: A change to the shared validator added a mandatory field that refund requests never supply, breaking all partial refunds for 4 hours.
root_cause: Shared validation library changed without refund regression run.

title: Rounding error on JPY payments
description: Zero-decimal currencies were multiplied by 100, overcharging customers.
root_cause: Minor-unit exponent hard-coded to 2.

title: Duplicate authorisation on client retry
description: Network retries created two authorisations for one order.
root_cause: Idempotency key not persisted before the acquirer call.

title: Stale FX rate applied after cache refresh failure
description: The rate cache served rates older than 6 hours without warning.
root_cause: Refresh failure swallowed, no rate-age assertion.

title: Transaction insert failed after schema migration
description: A NOT NULL column added without a default broke all writes on release night.
root_cause: Backward-incompatible migration deployed before the service change.

title: Reporting extract timed out after transaction table growth
description: The daily reconciliation query exceeded its 15 minute budget.
root_cause: Missing composite index on (settled_at, currency).

title: Ledger postings unbalanced for cross-currency refunds
description: Refunds converted at the current rate left a residual balance in the ledger.
root_cause: Refund used live rate instead of the original transaction rate.

title: Fraud score computed on pre-conversion amount
description: High-value foreign currency payments bypassed the review threshold.
root_cause: Screening used the request amount, not the base-currency amount.

title: Checkout hung when payment service was slow
description: No timeout on the payment call left checkout threads blocked.
root_cause: Missing client timeout and circuit breaker.

title: Order total mismatch versus authorised amount
description: Discount applied after authorisation caused capture failures.
root_cause: Total recalculated after the authorisation request was built.

title: Partial refund exceeded remaining refundable amount
description: Concurrent partial refunds each read a stale refunded total.
root_cause: No row-level lock on the refund aggregate.

title: Refund notification sent before refund settled
description: Customers were told money was returned while the refund still failed.
root_cause: Event published before the settlement callback.

title: Invoice numbering gap after failed transaction
description: A rolled-back invoice consumed a sequence number, creating an audit gap.
root_cause: Sequence allocated inside the transaction that rolled back.

title: Invoice amount formatted with wrong currency symbol
description: Multi-currency invoices always rendered the merchant's home symbol.
root_cause: Formatter defaulted to the locale currency.

title: MFA challenge skipped for remembered devices after token refresh
description: A refreshed token reset the device trust flag, skipping step-up auth.
root_cause: Device trust claim not propagated into refreshed tokens.

title: Session not revoked on password change
description: Old access tokens stayed valid for 30 minutes after a reset.
root_cause: Revocation list not consulted by the gateway.

title: Profile page save button silently failed
description: Validation errors from the user service were not surfaced in the UI.
root_cause: Error response body ignored by the portal form handler.

title: Profile address update lost the default flag
description: Editing an address cleared the default-shipping marker.
root_cause: Partial update overwrote the whole address document.

title: Gateway returned 502 during auth service deployment
description: Token introspection had no retry, so all traffic failed during rollout.
root_cause: No retry/backoff on introspection calls.

title: Email template rendered raw placeholders
description: A template variable rename left {{order_id}} visible to customers.
root_cause: Template and payload changed in separate releases.

title: Notification retries duplicated order confirmation emails
description: At-least-once delivery without deduplication sent up to five copies.
root_cause: No dedup key on the notification consumer.

title: Cancellation left stock reserved
description: Cancelling after authorisation released payment but not inventory.
root_cause: Compensating action missing in the cancellation saga.

title: Authorisation succeeded but transaction row was never written
description: A database failover during capture lost the write while funds moved.
root_cause: No outbox pattern between acquirer call and persistence.

title: Validator rejected valid amounts above 10,000
description: A hard-coded ceiling blocked legitimate high-value B2B payments.
root_cause: Business limit hard-coded instead of merchant configuration.

title: Fraud service latency spike blocked checkout
description: A vendor slowdown propagated straight into the checkout path.
root_cause: Synchronous screening without a fail-open policy.

title: Ledger reconciliation job double-counted refunds
description: Refund reversal rows were summed twice in the daily report.
root_cause: Join fan-out on the refund reversal table.

title: Currency service returned rates with wrong precision
description: Rates truncated to 4 decimals caused cent-level settlement drift.
root_cause: Float rounding in the rate serialiser.

title: Portal checkout button double-submitted the order
description: Rapid clicks created two orders before the button disabled.
root_cause: No submit lock in the checkout component.

title: Depart Test key missing while onboard is in CUT OUT state
description: The Depart Test key was not offered on Menu 1 when the onboard segment was in the CUT OUT state even though all other preconditions of L2R367 were satisfied.
root_cause: Key availability check enumerated ACTIVE and DISENGAGED only.

title: Brake pipe pressure prompt shown with a valid feed valve status
description: The TBC246 psi prompt was displayed even though a valid feed valve setting status had been received, blocking the departure test.
root_cause: Feed valve validity flag evaluated before the status message was latched.

title: Cut out switch transition annunciated late
description: Crew annunciation of a Cut Out transition exceeded the TBC005 second budget.
root_cause: Discrete polling interval longer than the annunciation budget.

title: Departure test result not recorded for the back office
description: A passed departure test was shown to the crew but never uploaded.
root_cause: Result record written after the session closed.

title: Position declared determined with excessive uncertainty
description: Position determined was declared while uncertainty exceeded TBC030 feet.
root_cause: Uncertainty compared against the wrong configuration parameter.

title: Track database version mismatch did not force DISENGAGED
description: The onboard stayed ACTIVE with a stale track database version.
root_cause: Version comparison ignored the minor revision field.

title: Stale WIU status treated as current
description: A WIU status message older than TBC060 seconds was used for enforcement.
root_cause: Message timestamp compared against receipt time, not train time.

title: Menu 1 soft keys reordered after a display reset
description: Key order differed from the defined layout following an HMI restart.
root_cause: Menu built from an unordered map after reset.

title: Stock oversold during flash sale
description: Two customers were charged for the last unit during a flash sale; one order had to be cancelled.
root_cause: Reservation used read-modify-write without a row lock.

title: Shipping label generated for the wrong carrier service
description: Next-day orders were labelled for the standard service because the new service code had no carrier mapping.
root_cause: Carrier mapping table not updated for new service codes.

title: Catalog showed in-stock items as unavailable
description: Product pages showed 'Out of stock' for up to 10 minutes after stock was replenished.
root_cause: Availability cache lived longer than the inventory update interval.

title: Coupon applied twice on a retried checkout
description: A checkout retried after a timeout redeemed the same coupon twice on one order.
root_cause: Promotion redemption was not idempotent per order.

title: Loyalty points kept after order cancellation
description: Points stayed on the account after the order was cancelled, letting customers redeem unearned rewards.
root_cause: The loyalty service did not consume order cancellation events.

title: Subscription renewal charged in the wrong currency
description: EUR plans renewed in USD for customers whose account default currency was USD.
root_cause: Renewal used the account default currency instead of the plan currency.

title: Wallet balance went negative under concurrent spends
description: Two parallel spends passed the balance check at the same time and left the wallet at -40 EUR.
root_cause: Balance check and debit ran in separate transactions.

title: Chargeback reversal posted twice to the ledger
description: A scheme webhook retried three times and the reversal was posted twice to the ledger.
root_cause: Webhook retries were not de-duplicated.

title: Merchant payout released before KYC approval
description: A merchant whose KYC had been rejected received a payout because the job used a cached status.
root_cause: Payout job read a cached KYC status.

title: Tax rounded per line instead of per invoice
description: Invoices with many lines showed a total one cent higher than the order.
root_cause: Rounding applied at the wrong aggregation level.

title: KYC accepted an expired identity document
description: A merchant was onboarded with a passport that had expired two months earlier.
root_cause: Document expiry date was not validated.

title: Marketing email sent after consent withdrawal
description: Customers kept receiving promotional emails for a day after withdrawing consent.
root_cause: Notification service read consent from a nightly snapshot.

title: Audit trail missing MFA reset events
description: MFA resets performed by support agents did not appear in the audit trail.
root_cause: Event type was not whitelisted in the audit publisher.

title: Search returned products from disabled categories
description: Search results included products from a category that had been disabled.
root_cause: Index rebuild ignored the category status.

title: Mobile sessions not revoked on password change
description: Mobile app sessions stayed valid for hours after the customer changed their password.
root_cause: Mobile backend cached tokens beyond the revocation list.

title: Payment events published out of order
description: Ledger consumers received captures before authorisations for the same payment.
root_cause: Partition key used merchant id instead of transaction id.

title: Support portal refund above the captured amount
description: An agent refunded more than the captured amount because the portal skipped refund validation.
root_cause: Portal called the refund store directly and bypassed the shared validation.

title: Nightly finance extract double counted refunds
description: The nightly extract counted refund reversals twice, overstating refunds in the finance dashboard.
root_cause: Join on refunds duplicated reversal rows.

title: Gift card redeemed after expiry
description: Gift cards could be redeemed for several hours after expiry for customers in later timezones.
root_cause: Expiry was compared without the card's timezone.

title: Approved return did not trigger a refund
description: Approved returns did not trigger refunds, and customers had to chase support for their money.
root_cause: RMA status change did not publish the refund event.

title: Checkout failed when the inventory service timed out
description: Checkout returned HTTP 500 when the Inventory Service was slow, instead of failing gracefully.
root_cause: No timeout or fallback on the stock reservation call.

title: Wallet top-up message sent before capture
description: Customers received a 'top-up successful' message even when the card payment later failed capture.
root_cause: Notification was triggered on authorisation instead of capture.

title: Overspeed warning displayed after enforcement started
description: The overspeed warning appeared after the penalty brake application had already started.
root_cause: Warning timer started from the enforcement threshold instead of the warning threshold.

title: Consist length ignored in the braking curve
description: The braking curve used a default train length when the crew left the optional length field blank.
root_cause: Default consist length used when the field was optional.

title: Event recorder lost records on power cycle
description: Event recorder entries from the last 30 seconds were lost when power was removed.
root_cause: Buffer flushed only on a graceful shutdown.

title: Speed restriction applied to the wrong track
description: A restriction for track 02 was enforced on track 2 of a different line.
root_cause: Track number parsed as an integer and lost its leading zero.

title: Restrictive signal aspect decoded as clear
description: A restrictive aspect code was decoded as clear after a firmware update shifted the aspect table.
root_cause: Aspect code table off by one after the firmware update.

title: Self-test passed with a failed GPS antenna
description: The self-test passed although the GPS antenna cable was disconnected.
root_cause: Antenna check reported a cached result.

title: Radio link loss not annunciated to the crew
description: Loss of the radio link was not shown to the crew because empty keep-alive frames reset the timer.
root_cause: Loss timer reset by keep-alive frames with no payload.

title: Crew login accepted a blank employee ID
description: Crew login succeeded with an empty employee ID field.
root_cause: Empty string passed the length check.
